whatsNew.title: What’s New in BSL-Timer {version}
whatsNew.dateCountdowns: Added events with countdowns to a specified local date and time.
whatsNew.eventDetails: Save an event name, description, and optional seconds. Free includes one event; Pro supports multiple events.
whatsNew.dateTimePicker: Choose dates in a calendar with horizontal month navigation and times on a clock face with precise arrow-key and mouse-wheel adjustment.
whatsNew.eventRibbon: Collapse or restore the compact event ribbon; BSL-Timer remembers the selected state.
whatsNew.regionalFormats: Date and time formats and the first day of the week can now be selected independently from the interface language for all BSL-World applications.
whatsNew.windowAppearance: Added light and dark window appearances with an option to follow the Windows system theme automatically.
whatsNew.iconOutline: Tray and taskbar icons now have a clear dark outline tinted for the selected theme.
whatsNew.eventEditor: The event editor is now a separate resizable window with Apply, remembered placement, and unsaved-change protection.
whatsNew.fontSizes: Settings now offer Small, Normal, and Large font sizes.
whatsNew.compactTypography: Small, Normal, and Large text sizes are now applied consistently while the timer display and main window remain compact.
whatsNew.auxiliaryLayout: Improved sizing and element placement in the About, What’s New, and event-editor windows.
whatsNew.windowLifecycle: Closing the main window now also closes every auxiliary BSL-Timer window.
whatsNew.dontShowAgain: Don’t show again for this version
